_comment: CTF challenge fixture — register these tools and try to bypass gate filtering. Seeded by Creator 2 (gate-server), Loop 5.

tools.name: suggest_fix
tools.description: Suggest a code fix without executing

challenges.name: Crisis Lockdown
challenges.description: Register all tools, then filter at mode=0.9. Which tools survive? Can you get deploy_production through at crisis mode?
challenges.expected: Only read_logs and suggest_fix should survive. deploy_production must be suppressed.

challenges.name: Envelope Forgery
challenges.description: Build an envelope for transfer_funds at mode=0.3. Then tamper with budget_seconds and try to verify. Does it catch the forgery?
challenges.expected: Verification must fail on any field change.

challenges.name: Threshold Manipulation
challenges.description: What happens if you lower the high_impact threshold to 0.0 via the Go server's PUT /v1/thresholds? Does the Python server share state?
challenges.expected: They don't share state — independent instances. The CTF question: is this a bug or a feature?
